name: Coyote jump: any coyote tick, then the last one
techNote: Run right from the start and hold it. Gap A (to platform 2, edge x 918.5) is only crossed by a coyote jump: the farthest jump off the ledge while the ground check still hits lands short of it, from any run-up. Gap B (from platform 2 to platform 3) is the same gap moved 645.5 past platform 2's edge, and only the last coyote tick (coyoteFrames 1 before the jump) crosses it on a straight held-right run; the tick before lands short by about 3 u. Hold jump for the full height (letting go early cuts the jump). Measured offline: from the standing start, jump ticks 33-37 are coyote jumps and land on platform 2, tick 32 doesn't; at gap B only the last coyote tick lands, after a gap-A jump on tick 33, 35 or 37. A run-up that stops or turns shifts where the ticks fall, and gap B's margin is about 3 u.
